# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

This repository's engineering standards are authoritative. The canonical source of truth is [../AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), and the detailed standards live under [../docs/development-standards](../docs/development-standards).

## Required behavior

- Read the relevant standards before making code changes.
- Follow the repository's existing architecture, naming conventions, and testing expectations.
- Prefer minimal, correct, focused changes.
- Protect security, data integrity, and backward compatibility.
- Validate with the smallest relevant checks available.
